passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David was the king of Israel.
David trusted God.
David often prayed to God.
David praised God in his songs.

passages.text: The LORD is my light and my salvation— whom shall I fear? The LORD is the stronghold of my life— whom shall I dread?
passages.sermon:
David speaks these words.
The LORD is my light.
The LORD is my salvation.
I do not need to fear anyone.
The LORD is the stronghold of my life.
I do not need to dread anyone.
passages.original: לְדָוִ֨ד׀ יְהוָ֤ה׀ אוֹרִ֣י וְ֭יִשְׁעִי מִמִּ֣י אִירָ֑א יְהוָ֥ה מָֽעוֹז־ חַ֝יַּ֗י מִמִּ֥י אֶפְחָֽד׃

passages.text: When the wicked came upon me to devour my flesh, my enemies and foes stumbled and fell.
passages.sermon:
Wicked people came near me.
They wanted to destroy me.
These people were my enemies.
They were also my foes.
They stumbled.
They fell.
passages.original: בִּקְרֹ֤ב עָלַ֨י׀ מְרֵעִים֮ לֶאֱכֹ֪ל אֶת־ בְּשָׂ֫רִ֥י צָרַ֣י וְאֹיְבַ֣י לִ֑י הֵ֖מָּה כָשְׁל֣וּ וְנָפָֽלוּ׃

passages.text: Though an army encamps around me, my heart will not fear; though a war breaks out against me, I will keep my trust.
passages.sermon:
David speaks in this psalm.
David trusts the LORD.
If an army surrounds me, I will not be afraid.
If a war rises against me, I will still trust the LORD.
My heart will not fear.
passages.original: אִם־ תַּחֲנֶ֬ה עָלַ֨י׀ מַחֲנֶה֮ לֹֽא־ יִירָ֪א לִ֫בִּ֥י אִם־ תָּק֣וּם עָ֭לַי מִלְחָמָ֑ה בְּ֝זֹ֗את אֲנִ֣י בוֹטֵֽחַ׃

passages.text: One thing I have asked of the LORD; this is what I desire: to dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to gaze on the beauty of the LORD and seek Him in His temple.
passages.sermon:
David is the speaker in this psalm.
David asks the LORD for one thing.
David desires this one thing above all else.
David wants to live in the house of the LORD.
David wants to stay there every day of his life.
David wants to look at the beauty of the LORD.
David wants to seek the LORD in His temple.
passages.original: אַחַ֤ת׀ שָׁאַ֣לְתִּי מֵֽאֵת־ יְהוָה֮ אוֹתָ֪הּ אֲבַ֫קֵּ֥שׁ שִׁבְתִּ֣י בְּבֵית־ יְ֭הוָה כָּל־ יְמֵ֣י חַיַּ֑י לַחֲז֥וֹת בְּנֹֽעַם־ יְ֝הוָ֗ה וּלְבַקֵּ֥ר בְּהֵיכָלֽוֹ׃

passages.text: For in the day of trouble He will hide me in His shelter; He will conceal me under the cover of His tent; He will set me high upon a rock.
passages.sermon:
God protects me.
He hides me in His shelter when trouble comes.
He keeps me safe under the cover of His tent.
He lifts me up high on a rock.
passages.original: כִּ֤י יִצְפְּנֵ֨נִי׀ בְּסֻכֹּה֮ בְּי֪וֹם רָ֫עָ֥ה יַ֭סְתִּרֵנִי בְּסֵ֣תֶר אָהֳל֑וֹ בְּ֝צ֗וּר יְרוֹמְמֵֽנִי׃

passages.text: Then my head will be held high above my enemies around me. At His tabernacle I will offer sacrifices with shouts of joy; I will sing and make music to the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD protects me.
He lifts my head high above my enemies.
My enemies surround me.
I stand above them because of the LORD.
I go to the LORD’s tent.
There, I offer sacrifices with loud shouts of joy.
I sing to the LORD.
I make music to the LORD.
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֨ה יָר֪וּם רֹאשִׁ֡י עַ֤ל אֹֽיְבַ֬י סְֽבִיבוֹתַ֗י וְאֶזְבְּחָ֣ה בְ֭אָהֳלוֹ זִבְחֵ֣י תְרוּעָ֑ה אָשִׁ֥ירָה וַ֝אֲזַמְּרָ֗ה לַיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Hear, O LORD, my voice when I call; be merciful and answer me.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
I call out to the LORD with my voice.
LORD, hear me.
Show me mercy.
Answer me.
passages.original: שְׁמַע־ יְהוָ֖ה קוֹלִ֥י אֶקְרָ֗א וְחָנֵּ֥נִי וַעֲנֵֽנִי׃

passages.text: My heart said, “Seek His face.” Your face, O LORD, I will seek.
passages.sermon:
David speaks in this psalm.
David is a man who trusts God.
David listens to his heart.
David’s heart tells him, “Seek God’s face.”
David responds to his heart.
David says, “O LORD, I will seek Your face.”
passages.original: לְךָ֤׀ אָמַ֣ר לִ֭בִּי בַּקְּשׁ֣וּ פָנָ֑י אֶת־ פָּנֶ֖יךָ יְהוָ֣ה אֲבַקֵּֽשׁ׃

passages.text: Hide not Your face from me, nor turn away Your servant in anger. You have been my helper; do not leave me or forsake me, O God of my salvation.
passages.sermon:
The speaker addresses the LORD.
The LORD is the God of salvation.
The speaker asks the LORD not to hide His face.
The speaker asks the LORD not to turn away from His servant in anger.
The LORD has been the speaker’s helper.
The speaker asks the LORD not to leave him.
The speaker asks the LORD not to forsake him.
passages.original: אַל־ תַּסְתֵּ֬ר פָּנֶ֨יךָ׀ מִמֶּנִּי֮ אַֽל־ תַּט־ בְּאַ֗ף עַ֫בְדֶּ֥ךָ עֶזְרָתִ֥י הָיִ֑יתָ אַֽל־ תִּטְּשֵׁ֥נִי וְאַל־ תַּֽ֝עַזְבֵ֗נִי אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׁעִֽי׃

passages.text: Though my father and mother forsake me, the LORD will receive me.
passages.sermon:
My father may leave me.
My mother may leave me.
The LORD will receive me.
The LORD will accept me.
passages.original: כִּי־ אָבִ֣י וְאִמִּ֣י עֲזָב֑וּנִי וַֽיהוָ֣ה יַֽאַסְפֵֽנִי׃

passages.text: Teach me Your way, O LORD, and lead me on a level path, because of my oppressors.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is my God.
I ask the LORD to teach me His way.
I want to know the LORD’s path.
I ask the LORD to lead me.
I want to walk on a level path.
I need this because I have oppressors.
passages.original: ה֤וֹרֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֗ה דַּ֫רְכֶּ֥ךָ וּ֭נְחֵנִי בְּאֹ֣רַח מִישׁ֑וֹר לְ֝מַ֗עַן שׁוֹרְרָֽי׃

passages.text: Do not hand me over to the will of my foes, for false witnesses rise up against me, breathing out violence.
passages.sermon:
David speaks to the LORD.
David asks the LORD for help.
David says, "Do not let my enemies control me."
David explains, "False witnesses stand against me."
David says, "They speak lies about me."
David says, "They want to harm me."
David asks the LORD to protect him from these people.
passages.original: אַֽל־ תִּ֭תְּנֵנִי בְּנֶ֣פֶשׁ צָרָ֑י כִּ֥י קָֽמוּ־ בִ֥י עֵֽדֵי־ שֶׁ֝֗קֶר וִיפֵ֥חַ חָמָֽס׃

passages.text: Still I am certain to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
passages.sermon:
David speaks in this psalm.
David trusts God.
David believes he will see God's goodness.
David expects to see this goodness while he is alive.
David is confident in the LORD's kindness in the land of the living.
passages.original: לׅׄוּלֵׅׄ֗אׅׄ הֶ֭אֱמַנְתִּי לִרְא֥וֹת בְּֽטוּב־ יְהוָ֗ה בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חַיִּֽים׃

passages.text: Wait patiently for the LORD; be strong and courageous. Wait patiently for the LORD!
passages.sermon:
David speaks to the people.
He tells them to wait patiently for the LORD.
He tells them to be strong.
He tells them to be courageous.
He repeats his command.
He says, wait patiently for the LORD.
passages.original: קַוֵּ֗ה אֶל־ יְה֫וָ֥ה חֲ֭זַק וְיַאֲמֵ֣ץ לִבֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝קַוֵּ֗ה אֶל־ יְהוָֽה׃
